verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries across several ecosystems: a Ruby gem with a CLI, Python, Cocoa/iOS, JS packages with automatic instrumentation, and an Oban integration. Its docs also distinguish officially supported languages from unsupported ones, which confirms an official SDK lineup. These SDKs center on reporting errors and telemetry, though, and there is no evidence of SDKs for the read/management REST APIs (faults, projects), and the probe found no OpenAPI spec for generating clients. Missing for 10: official SDKs or a machine-readable spec for the management/query APIs, a documented full list of supported languages, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
